name: gt-pilot
description: Shape tones on your BOSS GT-1 by talking to Claude: ask for a song, say what sounds off, and hear it change.
long_description:
Connect a BOSS GT-1 over USB and talk to Claude about your tone. Ask for the sound of a song, say it needs more drive or sounds muddy, and the change is applied live on the pedal. Claude can also listen through the GT-1's USB audio to measure loudness and noise, level your patches, clean up string noise, and run a metronome.

Safety is built in: volume rises in small steps, nothing overwrites a saved patch without asking, every change can be undone, and every save keeps a backup.

Requirements: a BOSS GT-1, its USB driver, and BOSS TONE STUDIO for GT-1 installed (it is read for the parameter map and does not need to be open; keep it closed while using this extension).

Free and open source (MIT). Independent project, not affiliated with BOSS or Roland Corporation; BOSS and GT-1 are trademarks of Roland Corporation.
